[Distant Archer](/Feats.aspx?ID=5328) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 32

</column>

---

You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target. You reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first [range increment](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) by 1, to a minimum of 0, when using weapons in the [bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3) weapon group.
